features.name: Flower Catalog Browsing
features.description: Customers can browse, search, and filter flowers and bouquets with photos, prices, and availability.
user_stories: As a customer, I can browse and filter flowers by category, price, and occasion so that I find the right bouquet quickly.
As a customer, I can view a flower's details, photos, and availability so that I can decide confidently.
acceptance_criteria: Given the catalog page, When I apply a category or price filter, Then only matching items are displayed.
Given a product is out of stock, When I view it, Then it is marked unavailable and cannot be added to the cart.

features.name: Cart and Order Placement
features.description: Customers can add items to a cart, choose a delivery date and address, and place an order with online payment.
user_stories: As a customer, I can add flowers to a cart and set a delivery date and address so that I can schedule my delivery.
As a customer, I can pay securely online and receive an order confirmation so that I know my order was accepted.
acceptance_criteria: Given items in my cart, When I submit a valid address, date, and payment, Then an order is created and a confirmation is sent.
Given a payment fails, When I submit the order, Then no order is created and I see an error message with a retry option.

features.name: Delivery Tracking
features.description: Customers can track order status from preparation through delivery to their door.
user_stories: As a customer, I can see my order status in real time so that I know when to expect my flowers.
As a courier, I can update delivery status and mark orders delivered so that customers stay informed.
acceptance_criteria: Given an active order, When its status changes, Then the customer sees the update within 30 seconds.
Given a courier marks an order delivered, When the update is saved, Then the customer is notified and the order is closed.

features.name: User Accounts and Order History
features.description: Customers can register, log in, manage saved addresses, and view past orders for easy reordering.
user_stories: As a customer, I can register and log in so that my details and orders are saved.
As a customer, I can view past orders and reorder them so that I can send flowers again quickly.
acceptance_criteria: Given valid details, When I register, Then my account is created and I am logged in.
Given a past order, When I select reorder, Then its items are added to my cart at current prices.

features.name: Admin Catalog and Order Management
features.description: Florist staff can manage flower inventory, prices, and incoming orders and assign deliveries to couriers.
user_stories: As an admin, I can add, edit, and remove flower products and stock levels so that the catalog stays accurate.
As an admin, I can view incoming orders and assign them to couriers so that deliveries are fulfilled on time.
acceptance_criteria: Given I update a product's price or stock, When I save, Then the catalog reflects the change immediately.
Given a new paid order, When I assign a courier, Then the courier sees it in their delivery list.

non_functional_requirements.requirement: Catalog pages load in under 2 seconds at 200 concurrent users.
All traffic uses HTTPS; passwords are hashed with bcrypt; card data is handled via PCI-DSS compliant Stripe.
The system achieves 99.5% monthly uptime, excluding scheduled maintenance.
A first-time customer can complete an order in under 5 minutes in 90% of usability tests.
Customer addresses and contact data are encrypted at rest and deleted within 30 days of an account deletion request.
